decisions.statement: A status other than 403 matches nothing.
A body with no Anthropic error envelope matches nothing.
An envelope naming an error type other than `permission_error` matches nothing.
A body carrying keys the envelope does not name still matches.
A match has the envelope message as the reason.
A match reading an envelope with no message has `permission_error` as the reason.
Nothing here sees a response beyond the status and the body.
An envelope message that is an empty string becomes an empty reason.

definition: what a 403 body says about upstream refusing the caller permission
